title: Planning vocabulary v0.1
description: The closed role and capability catalogues, defined ONCE. They were restated in six places, so adding a role meant six coordinated edits and one missed edit silently accepted a value in some artifact types and refused it in others. The Go catalogues in domain/plan.go remain authoritative; schemas.TestTheSchemaVocabularyMatchesTheDomainCatalogue holds the two together.
